prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.rs with the public function at module scope.
Required API: pub fn dependencies_valid(nodes: &[&str], edges: &[(&str,&str)]) -> bool
Behavior: Return true exactly when node names are unique, every directed edge endpoint is declared, and the directed dependency graph is acyclic. Empty input is valid.
Visible example: nodes [parse, build, ship] with parse->build and build->ship is valid; adding ship->parse makes it invalid.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: use std::collections::{HashMap,HashSet};pub fn dependencies_valid(n:&[&str],e:&[(&str,&str)])->bool{let k:HashSet<_>=n.iter().copied().collect();if k.len()!=n.len(){return false}let mut d:HashMap<&str,usize>=n.iter().map(|x|(*x,0)).collect();let mut g:HashMap<&str,Vec<&str>>=HashMap::new();for &(a,b)in e{if !k.contains(a)||!k.contains(b){return false}g.entry(a).or_default().push(b);*d.get_mut(b).unwrap()+=1}let mut q:Vec<_>=d.iter().filter(|x|*x.1==0).map(|x|*x.0).collect();let mut seen=0;while let Some(x)=q.pop(){seen+=1;for y in g.get(x).into_iter().flatten(){let z=d.get_mut(y).unwrap();*z-=1;if *z==0{q.push(y)}}}seen==n.len()}
